task:
ADD GITHUB ANNOTATION SUMMARIES TO PRODUCTION RECEIPTS SO AN OPERATOR WHO CANNOT DOWNLOAD ARTIFACTS OR LOGS CAN READ RESULTS.

Follow the existing pattern already used in .github/workflows/chatgpt-ed-new-ops.yml for 'Host storage detail' / 'Host clean-up' annotations and in .github/workflows/v3-derived-purge-rehearsal.yml ('Purge rehearsal stopped'): an `if: always()` step that reads the receipt JSON with Python, builds a bounded summary, escapes '%', CR and LF for GitHub command data, keeps each annotation under 4000 characters, emits at most 8 annotations, and never prints secrets, DSNs, environment values or credential-bearing text.

Add summaries for:
1. .github/workflows/v3-production-schema-migration.yml (plan and apply): one `::notice title=Schema migration::` with status, operation, failures, source_sha, applied_before count and the last applied ledger name, pending ledger names, applied_now ledger names, database_writes_performed, migrations_performed, schema_identity_updated, schema_identity_before_sha256/after_sha256 (first 12 hex), desired_ledger_sha256 (first 19 chars incl 'sha256:'). Use ::error instead of ::notice when status is not 'planned'/'applied' or failures is non-empty. The receipt path is whatever that workflow already uploads; read it, do not change what it uploads.
2. chatgpt-ed-new-ops.yml operation v3-derived-lifecycle-status: the step currently streams the action and prints the JSON receipt only to the log. Capture stdout to $RUNNER_TEMP/v3-derived-lifecycle-status.json with tee (keep the step's exit status exactly as today: the step must still fail when the action exits non-zero), upload it as artifact v3-derived-lifecycle-status-receipt (if: always(), if-no-files-found: warn, 30 days), and annotate `::notice title=Derived lifecycle status::` with status, failures, all_named_workers_stopped, each worker name with running/exists/status/exit_code, migration_apply_preconditions, finder_migrations_applied, finder_products_on_published_generation, derived generation keys with lifecycle_state, derived_products (generation_key, product_code, lifecycle_state), footprint.host_disk avail_bytes and size_bytes (human GiB too), postgres.wal archive_mode/failed_count/last_archived_time/last_failed_time.
3. chatgpt-ed-new-ops.yml operation v3-backup-wrapper-install: annotate `::notice title=Backup wrapper install::` from its existing receipt with status, failures, source_sha256 and installed_sha256 (first 12 hex each), wrapper_temp_written, wrapper_installed, installed_hash_verified and every *_writes_performed / *_changes_performed flag.

Add tests (extend the existing workflow tests, e.g. tests/test_v3_derived_purge_ops_workflow.py, the schema migration workflow tests, tests/test_v3_backup_wrapper_install.py) that execute each summary snippet against sample receipts (success, failure, missing/invalid receipt) and assert: correct title/level, required fields present, escaping, the 4000-character bound, and that a secret-looking value placed in an unrelated receipt field never appears. Keep every existing contract test green; update tests/test_ci_stall_detection.py only if a new workflow file is added (it should not be). Run ruff, actionlint on the touched workflows, pytest on the touched tests; `python scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py --operation authority-gate` must report failures []. Do not dispatch any workflow.
